pagePlan.primaryGoal: Explore real menu and plan a visit or ask via official WhatsApp.

candidates.rationale: House-centered olive album has a visible relationship to real location photography and memory booth.
Product-first typographic book cover rejected because real crop resolution cannot carry a large opening and house becomes secondary.

brand.type: Archivo Black source-compatible broad sans heading, DM Sans body; retained original raster wordmark. Exact official font unconfirmed.

pagePlan.mobile: Centered title and facade with overlapping side prints; compact menu pages, wide room and interactive memory album, stacked practical location.
pagePlan.componentProvenance: Official shadcn Button, Input, Select copied locally; Base UI behavior preserved.

contentCoverage.finding: all unique PDF offerings and price variants

mediaCoverage.limitations: Raster source crops are small; use compact thumbnails. Original source photographs retain watermark and pending rights. No AI food images.

observations.observation: Recurring olive grounds with cream uppercase text; campaigns add mustard and red, while partner sports posters use blue.
observations.translation: Olive opening, near-white reading surface and light-green practical location. Archived palette statement not newly live verified.

observations.observation: MENU is broad block sans; category headings are dense bold sans, body is compact and rounded; wordmark has distinctive rounded strokes.
observations.translation: Archivo Black provides broad block heading strokes with DM Sans body and original logo; exact source font unconfirmed.

observations.observation: Posters frame products and people with large compact headline blocks, cutout dishes and source color grounds.
observations.translation: Oversized centered title above facade-dominant album and two smaller real place prints. Intentionally adapts poster density to a responsive photo narrative.

observations.observation: Named dishes are isolated on patterned plates, set on paper; place sources show warm wood, vintage furniture and greenery.
observations.translation: Real door/interior/booth images carry opening and room narrative; exact low-resolution crops remain compact in book leaves.

observations.observation: Four-petal wallpaper motif, paper texture, olive/mustard/red inset frames repeat through menu pages.
observations.translation: Original motif beside the menu heading, square print borders and restrained book rules; no arch or decorative pill.

retained: Unaltered rounded raster wordmark; archived olive palette; broad sans print hierarchy.
Actual wooden interiors, green door, source four-petal motif and exact dish crops.
adapted: House photographs arranged as an album rather than old split hero.
Archivo Black and DM Sans retained open-license substitutes; exact brand font is unknown.
Menu rendered as bounded two-leaf pages with eight items, not unbounded repeated cards.
avoidedDefaults: Cream plus Georgia serif split hero removed.
No arch masks, decorative pills or eyebrows.
No duplicated slogan or invented reviews.
